fields.label: Name
fields.help: Follows this listener into every log line and audit event, so renaming it splits that history.

fields.label: Protocol
fields.help: Picks the codec that reads this listener's traffic.

fields.label: Listen on
fields.help: Where clients reach the sidecar: host:port, or a socket path on a unix transport.

fields.label: Transport
fields.help: A unix socket opens no port, so filesystem permissions decide who can connect.

fields.label: Upstream
fields.help: Where the sidecar reaches your resource.

fields.label: Upstream TLS
fields.help: Encrypts the hop to the backend. The sidecar is the TLS client there, so it still reads the traffic.

fields.label: CA file
fields.help: Verifies the backend. Empty uses the host trust store. A path on the sidecar host.

fields.label: Certificate file
fields.help: A path on the sidecar host. Upstream, it is the client certificate for mTLS.

fields.label: Key file
fields.help: A path on the sidecar host.

fields.label: Server name
fields.help: Overrides SNI when the dial address differs from the certificate name.

fields.label: Skip certificate verification
fields.help: The sidecar logs a warning at startup. Do not ship this.

fields.label: MySQL auth key file
fields.help: RSA private key clients can pin, so the relay can read RSA password exchanges. Needs upstream TLS. A path on the sidecar host.

fields.label: Downstream TLS
fields.help: Terminates the client's TLS on this listener. Leave both empty when something in front already does.

fields.label: Certificate file
fields.help: A path on the sidecar host. Upstream, it is the client certificate for mTLS.

fields.label: Key file
fields.help: A path on the sidecar host.

fields.label: Identity header
fields.help: The header carrying the authenticated subject. Only trust it when nothing but your proxy can reach this listener.

fields.label: Idle timeout (seconds)
fields.help: 0 disables it. A short value breaks interactive sessions.

fields.label: Max connections
fields.help: 0 is unlimited.

fields.label: HTTP
fields.help: What this listener's codec reads out of a request.

fields.label: Capture the request body
fields.help: Needed by AI analysis on an HTTP listener.

fields.label: Max body bytes
fields.help: 0 uses the codec default of 64 KiB.

fields.label: Headers
fields.help: Allowlist exposed to policy. Authorization, cookie, proxy-authorization and set-cookie are always refused.

fields.label: Sensitive query parameters
fields.help: Extra parameter names whose value is redacted before anything sees the request.

fields.label: ClickHouse
fields.help: Decompression limits. 0 keeps the codec defaults.

fields.label: Max frame bytes
fields.help: 0 keeps the default of 16 MiB.

fields.label: Max block bytes
fields.help: 0 keeps the default of 64 MiB.

fields.label: gRPC
fields.help: What this listener decodes and exposes to policy.

fields.label: Descriptors
fields.help: Protobuf descriptor sets, as paths on the sidecar host or gs:// URLs. Sets merge.

fields.label: Capture the payload
fields.help: Needed for masking, PII and AI analysis on this listener.

fields.label: Max payload bytes
fields.help: 0 uses the lane default.

fields.label: Strict decoding
fields.help: Refuses an RPC whose payload the descriptors cannot read.

fields.label: Metadata
fields.help: Allowlist exposed to policy. The same four headers HTTP refuses are refused here.

fields.label: Spanner
fields.help: The SQL dialect each database speaks.

fields.label: Dialect
fields.help: The lane default. Under per_database, a database not listed below is not guessed at.

fields.label: Databases
fields.help: A database resource name and the dialect it speaks.

fields.label: SSH
fields.help: The keys this listener trusts and what a session may do.

fields.label: Host key
fields.help: The private host key this listener presents. A path on the sidecar host.

fields.label: Trusted CA
fields.help: authorized_keys file naming the CA keys a user certificate must be signed by. A path on the sidecar host.

fields.label: Restrict capabilities
fields.help: Off admits every capability below. On admits only the ones picked, and picking none admits none.

fields.label: Forward destinations
fields.help: A network prefix with an optional port, such as 10.0.0.0/8:5432 or 10.0.0.5/32, or any. Empty denies every forward.

fields.label: Identity mapping
fields.help: Which field of the user's certificate fills each identity slot that policy and the audit trail read. Empty uses the key id as the subject.

fields.label: Subject
fields.help: The certificate field holding the user's name: key_id, principals or extensions.<name>.

fields.label: Email
fields.help: The certificate field holding the user's email.

fields.label: Groups
fields.help: The certificate field holding the user's groups. Not hoop groups: the ones the certificate carries.

fields.label: Certificate extensions
fields.help: Extensions whose values reach policy and the audit trail, such as permit-pty. Not hoop attributes.
